column1: Power Finance Corporation Ltd. has been excluded from the index pursuant to its exclusion from Nifty Midcap
150 index (a parent index for Nifty Midcap Select index). Abbott India Ltd. and Balkrishna Industries Ltd. have
been excluded from the index as they do not form part of reranked universe as defined in the methodology
document for this index. Bandhan Bank Ltd. has been excluded to match the number of inclusions in the index
as it is ranked lowest based on 6 month average free float market capitalization amongst remaining index
